name: ECDH Key Agreement
description: Derive the same shared secret from two private keys, optionally followed by HKDF.

examples.label: Agree a shared secret on P-256
Agree on P-256 and derive with HKDF

hints.kdf: The shared secret must be passed through a KDF before use; never use the raw shared secret as a session key.
hints.curve: SM2 is not an agreement curve; ECDH supports the NIST curves plus X25519 / X448.

faq.q: Why do both sides get different results?
faq.a: Check that the curves match and that the public key was not compressed or converted.

faq.q: Are X25519 and P-256 shared secrets the same length?
faq.a: Not always: X25519 yields 32 bytes, P-256 32 bytes, P-384 48 bytes, P-521 66 bytes.
